verdict: FAIL — load-bearing defect, details below; do not merge until fixed + re-run
urgent_arm_walked: as requested: fixture carried one urgent item (out-202). route-urgent released on timer, escalate held for the human, released with 'act'; handle-urgent correctly refused to fabricate authorization from an empty release reason (safety pattern earned its keep).

defect_1_load_bearing.summary: The batch arm is NOT pruned on urgent runs: the 'exactly one arm' + 'the dead arm's descendants never spawn' claim is false for the write-capable fan-out.
defect_1_load_bearing.mechanism: batch-run declares after:[route-batch, classify]. prune_states (wfcommon.py:1418-1431) skips a node only when ALL its `after` deps are skipped. On has_urgent=true: route-batch=skipped but classify=done -> batch-run is a join with >=1 live dep -> it RUNS. The batch fan-out therefore mutates {run.action_target} concurrently while the escalate human gate holds — unattended writes beside a held approval.
defect_1_load_bearing.live_evidence: run 20261001-005725: classify emitted has_urgent=true AND routine=[pw-101,pw-102]; events.jsonl shows batch-run item.started at 00:59:31 while escalate was pending; ledger.txt gained 'DONE pw-101/pw-102' lines while the urgent item out-202 still waited on the human. Independently confirmed by three blind council seats replaying prune_states over the committed bytes (run 20261001-005618, synthesis verify-list).
defect_1_load_bearing.fix_direction: either (a) classifier contract: has_urgent=true MUST carry routine=[] (defer the batch; batch-run then fans out over an empty set — verify the engine's zero-item fan-out path commits done, not fanout_empty), or (b) restructure so the batch arm hangs on route-batch ONLY and the items travel through the gate path, or (c) raise the join/prune semantics question at WOFS as an engine-law item (not recommended as a silent semantics change). Author's call; haus estate re-runs on the fix.
defect_1_load_bearing.grade: safety-bearing: the template's own description promises the opposite of what happens; a copying estate gets ungated writes.

defect_2_minor.summary: escalate release semantics: options=['act','hold','dismiss'] but release answer is free text; an 'act' release WITHOUT an authorization reason correctly no-ops (handle-urgent refused). Template description should say: release with 'act <what was authorized>' or the urgent arm never executes.
defect_2_minor.grade: doc nit; the refusal behavior itself is correct and good.
